trans-unit.source: Comma-separated keys rendered as URL link, e.g. website and the social media keys. Values without https:// get it added automatically.
Outputs company, address, phone, fax, email and website from the site settings as <address>.
Share link of your Google Business profile: Google Maps → your business → Share → Copy link, e.g. https://maps.app.goo.gl/…. Used for the button "Plan route on Google Maps".

Google Maps → Share → Embed a map → Copy HTML. Paste the src URL (https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=…) or the whole <iframe> code. Only Google Maps embed URLs are accepted – share links (maps.app.goo.gl, share.google) do not work here. Required for the layouts "Compact (address & map)" and "Split (contact + map)". Empty = no map.
No data is sent to Google before the visitor clicks "Load map"
Loading the map transfers data to Google.
Official name exactly as in your Google Business profile (consistent NAP data). Placeholder: {{company}}
Street and house number, e.g. Bahnhofstrasse 4. Placeholder: {{street}}
Country name or ISO code, e.g. Switzerland or CH. Placeholder: {{country}}
International format recommended, e.g. +41 41 000 00 00. Spaces, hyphens and brackets are allowed – the tel: link uses digits and + only. Placeholder: {{phone}}
Same format as phone, e.g. +41 41 000 00 01. Placeholder: {{fax}}
Plain address without "mailto:", e.g. info@typo3.org. Spam protection (config.spamProtectEmailAddresses) applies. Placeholder: {{email}}
Full URL including https://, e.g. https://typo3.org. If https:// is missing it is added automatically. The text is shown exactly as entered. Placeholder: {{website}}
Shown above the owner / company name, e.g. President. Placeholder: {{profession}}
VAT identification number incl. country code, e.g. CHE-112.256.297 MWST. Placeholder: {{vatId}}
Content element "Address": icons instead of labels for phone, fax, email, website and route link – only if EXT:iconpack with Font Awesome (fa5, fa6 or fa7) is installed.
Name of the owner or contact person, shown in bold above the company, e.g. Olivier Dobberkau. Placeholder: {{person}}
Optional line below the street, e.g. 2nd floor. Placeholder: {{addressAddition}}

Layouts with map need the Google Maps embed URL in the site settings (Sites > Setup > Edit settings > Variables: links > "Google Maps embed URL (iframe src)", t3sVars.mapsEmbed). Without it no map is shown. The route button uses "Google Maps / Business profile link" (vars.maps).

Periods in schema.org format, separated by ";" – e.g. "Mo-Fr 08:00-17:00; Sa 09:00-12:00" (days: Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su). Shown localized ("Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00") and used for JSON-LD. Other entries (e.g. "by appointment") are shown as text. Placeholder: {{openingHours}}
Full profile URL, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/… Shown as icon link in the content element "Address" and used as sameAs in JSON-LD. Placeholder: {{facebook}}
Full profile URL, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/… Shown as icon link in the content element "Address" and used as sameAs in JSON-LD. Placeholder: {{instagram}}
Full profile URL, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/… Shown as icon link in the content element "Address" and used as sameAs in JSON-LD. Placeholder: {{linkedin}}
Full profile URL, e.g. https://www.xing.com/… Shown as icon link in the content element "Address" and used as sameAs in JSON-LD. Placeholder: {{xing}}
Full profile URL, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/… Shown as icon link in the content element "Address" and used as sameAs in JSON-LD. Placeholder: {{youtube}}
Full profile URL, e.g. https://www.x.com/… Shown as icon link in the content element "Address" and used as sameAs in JSON-LD. Placeholder: {{x}}
Full profile URL, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/… Shown as icon link in the content element "Address" and used as sameAs in JSON-LD. Placeholder: {{tiktok}}
Full profile URL, e.g. https://www.mastodon.com/… Shown as icon link in the content element "Address" and used as sameAs in JSON-LD. Placeholder: {{mastodon}}

Adds structured data with name, address, contact, opening hours and social profiles to the page head of every page. Requires "Company". Disable it if another extension already outputs LocalBusiness/Organization data.
schema.org type, e.g. LocalBusiness, Organization, ProfessionalService, Store, Restaurant, Dentist, LegalService.

Values per language, separated by ";": language code, key, "=", value – e.g. "en.country = Germany; en.profession = Web developer". Overrides the value for that language in RTE, Fluid, the content element and JSON-LD (not in TypoScript constants). Opening hours: separate periods with "|".

Content element "Address": link that downloads the contact as .vcf file (name, company, profession, address, phone, fax, email, website, social profiles) – for the address book on phone and computer. Generated on the page, no extra request.
